import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def matchesAtBool (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all
      (fun j => decide (haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0))

def kmpCandidates (haystack needle : Array UInt8) : List Nat :=
  (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
    (fun i => matchesAtBool haystack needle i)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kmpSearch (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  Array.mk (kmpCandidates haystack needle)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matchesAt (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matchesAt haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧ -- Soundness
  (∀ i, matchesAt haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i) -- Completeness
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem matchesAtBool_true_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    matchesAtBool haystack needle i = true ↔ matchesAt haystack needle i := by
  simp [matchesAtBool, matchesAt, List.mem_range]

theorem list_get_mem' {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (k : Nat) (h : k < xs.length) :
    xs.get ⟨k, h⟩ ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing k with
  | nil =>
      cases h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          simp
      | succ k =>
          have hk : k < xs.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h
          simpa using List.mem_cons_of_mem x (ih k hk)

theorem list_mem_get' {α : Type*} {x : α} :
    ∀ {xs : List α}, x ∈ xs → ∃ k, ∃ h : k < xs.length, xs.get ⟨k, h⟩ = x
  | [], h => by
      simp at h
  | y :: ys, h => by
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with hxy | hmem
      · refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
        simpa [hxy]
      · obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := list_mem_get' (x := x) hmem
        refine ⟨k + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hk, ?_⟩
        simpa using hget

@[simp]
theorem array_mk_size' {α : Type*} (xs : List α) :
    (Array.mk xs).size = xs.length := by
  simp [Array.size]

theorem array_mk_getD_of_lt {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (d : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    (Array.mk xs).getD i d = xs.get ⟨i, h⟩ := by
  simp only [Array.getD, Array.size]
  change (if hlt : i < xs.length then xs.get ⟨i, hlt⟩ else d) = xs.get ⟨i, h⟩
  split
  · rename_i hlt
    exact congrArg xs.get (Fin.ext rfl)
  · rename_i hnot
    exact False.elim (hnot h)

theorem kmpCandidates_sound {haystack needle : Array UInt8} {i : Nat}
    (hmem : i ∈ kmpCandidates haystack needle) :
    matchesAt haystack needle i := by
  have hmem' := hmem
  simp [kmpCandidates] at hmem'
  exact (matchesAtBool_true_iff haystack needle i).mp hmem'.2

theorem kmpCandidates_complete {haystack needle : Array UInt8} {i : Nat}
    (hmatch : matchesAt haystack needle i) :
    i ∈ kmpCandidates haystack needle := by
  have hiRange : i ∈ List.range (haystack.size + 1) := by
    rw [List.mem_range]
    have hfirst : i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size := hmatch.1
    omega
  have hb : matchesAtBool haystack needle i = true :=
    (matchesAtBool_true_iff haystack needle i).mpr hmatch
  simp [kmpCandidates, hiRange, hb]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kmpSearch_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) :
    kmpSearch_postcond haystack needle (kmpSearch haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold kmpSearch_postcond
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    have hi' : i < (kmpCandidates haystack needle).length := by
      simpa [kmpSearch] using hi
    have hmem :
        (kmpCandidates haystack needle).get ⟨i, hi'⟩ ∈ kmpCandidates haystack needle :=
      list_get_mem' (kmpCandidates haystack needle) i hi'
    change matchesAt haystack needle
      ((Array.mk (kmpCandidates haystack needle)).getD i 0)
    rw [array_mk_getD_of_lt (kmpCandidates haystack needle) i 0 hi']
    exact kmpCandidates_sound hmem
  · intro i hmatch
    have hmem : i ∈ kmpCandidates haystack needle :=
      kmpCandidates_complete hmatch
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := list_mem_get' hmem
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [kmpSearch] using hk
    · change (Array.mk (kmpCandidates haystack needle)).getD k 0 = i
      rw [array_mk_getD_of_lt (kmpCandidates haystack needle) k 0 hk]
      exact hget
  -- !benchmark @end proof

Main issue: the required algorithm is **Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP)**, with:
1. a preprocessing step computing the **LPS / next array**, and
2. a search loop that uses that LPS array to **skip comparisons on mismatch**.

The student does neither.

What the student actually implemented:
- `matchesAtBool haystack needle i` checks whether the pattern matches at a single position `i` by directly comparing all pattern positions using
  `List.range needle.size).all ...`.
- `kmpCandidates` enumerates **all positions** `0 .. haystack.size` and filters them by `matchesAtBool`.
- `kmpSearch` simply converts that filtered list to an array.

So this is a straightforward **naive search**:
- try every starting position,
- compare the whole pattern there.

This is not KMP, and it does not include any LPS computation or any skip/jump logic.
